method: Regenerate lower mesh at 0.02 mm linear and 0.08 rad angular settings in float64, recover two missing patches on existing CAD BSpline face 101 by constrained UV-boundary triangulation, and export float64 ASCII STL. No CAD geometry modification, no mesh simplification, no filling of designed cavities.
sampling_limit: Deviation sampled locally on recovered patches; not a certified global Hausdorff bound.
failed_attempt: 0.005 mm mesh had 13 open edges; directly triangulating its UV loops created nonmanifold edges and was rejected.
